decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf fits a German bakery's core assortment, costs little to keep producing, and was still featured on the website, so it is likely to stay.
The historic mill tour supports the firm's brand and heritage marketing at modest ongoing cost, although tours are a non-core activity and somewhat more likely to be discontinued.
A sweet pastry is a standard bakery item, and sweet assortments rotate more often than staple breads, but with no sign of weak results the firm would keep it.
